title: Check: Similar Shapes: Area and Volume

questions.stem: Two similar shapes have a length scale factor of $3$. What is the ratio of their areas?
questions.explanation: For similar shapes, the area ratio is the square of the length scale factor. Area ratio $= 3^2 = 9$, so the ratio is $1 : 9$.

questions.stem: Two similar solids have a length scale factor of $2$. What is the ratio of their volumes?
questions.explanation: For similar solids, the volume ratio is the cube of the length scale factor. Volume ratio $= 2^3 = 8$, so the ratio is $1 : 8$.
